questions.prompt: Which phrase is explicitly listed as a focus point for “Maintenance and Long-Term Support” in the supplied curriculum?

questions.prompt: Before using “Maintenance and Long-Term Support” in a real application, which practice is most reliable?

Assume a short example is production-safe because it looks simple.

Treat LuaJIT, Luau, and stock Lua 5.5 as the same runtime.
